name: SignalFire Sentinel Float Stick (Sentinel-FS-3BIS) via SignalFire Buffered Modbus Gateway
source: SignalFire Telemetry, Interface Manual - Tank Level Float Stick System, Rev 1.1 (2016-08-03), pages 9-10. Gateway addressing: SignalFire App Note - Getting Started with Modbus (2020-03-31).
notes: Read at the gateway, using the Slave ID configured in the node with SignalFire Toolkit (nodes ship as ID 1; IDs 241-255 are reserved for gateways, which ship as 247).
The gateway buffers the last check-in of each node (typically every 1-5 minutes). A request it cannot answer from the buffer returns a Modbus exception.
Single-float sticks return 0 for the interface level. Every reading becomes 999.9999 when the node cannot talk to the stick; the communication status then holds the cause.
Float word order is not stated in the manual; the adapter detects it from the span register (stick length in inches) unless wordOrder is set.
The node status registers (49988-49999) depend on gateway firmware; when the gateway rejects that block the adapter keeps going without battery, signal and timeout data.

commStatusCodes.1: no data received from the float stick
commStatusCodes.2: only partial data received from the float stick
commStatusCodes.3: checksum error talking to the float stick
commStatusCodes.4: float stick reported an internal error
